note: Sat 22 Aug 2026, ~08:20 SGT — weekend run; US/HK/SG markets closed. Latest completed session is FRIDAY 21 AUGUST (US/HK/SG); JP/KR still Thu 20 Aug per the spine. Builds on the prior catch-up (through Tue 18 Aug via Wed/Thu 19-20 Aug). WED 19 AUG: US Treasury doubled its long-end debt-buyback operation size after the 30Y touched a post-2007 high (~5.33%) — pulled the 10Y to 4.647% and 30Y to 5.196%, sent DXY to an 11-week low, and ignited a REAL precious-metals breakout: GLD +3.84%, SLV +4.47%, with miners leading (GDX +9.42%, SILJ +9.55%, Barrick +8.82%). THU 20 AUG: blockbuster US data plus a hawkish Musalem drove a genuine equity selloff — S&P -0.87%, Nasdaq -1.00%, Dow -1.32%, VIX +7.52% to 16.01 — even as gold/silver kept grinding higher; KOSPI round-tripped +5.89% on Samsung/SK Hynix capital-return plans. FRI 21 AUG — genuine risk-on reversal: S&P 7,674.37 (+0.43%), Dow 53,277.01 (+0.98%), Nasdaq 26,180.46 (+0.43%), Russell 2000 +0.85%, VIX 15.13 (-5.50%, more than reversing Thursday's spike); week overall S&P -1.4%/Dow -0.8%/Nasdaq -2.0%. Gold extended to a three-month high (~$4,661.60, +1.97% Fri). 10Y 4.73%, 30Y 5.27%. US national debt crossed $40T (20 Aug). Iran conflict escalated further (UAE suspended trade with Tehran; Hormuz shipping-data shows Iran still controls the strait). BITCOIN: Thu close verified $73,032.76 (+5.44%), continuing to a ~$77,862.74 weekend level (a LIVE QUOTE, not a close, per crypto rules — corrects the prior edition's unverifiable $74,859 figure).

flows.narrative: The week through 19 Aug showed a decisive rotation into safe-haven/defensive assets: money-market/cash funds drew the largest inflow ($25.4bn), bonds $23.8bn, and gold $6.3bn — its biggest weekly inflow since January 2026 — as BofA's Michael Hartnett reiterated a 'long gold, short USD' stance. Equities still drew a net $16.1bn but this was a slowdown versus prior weeks, consistent with the tech-led deleveraging that JPMorgan separately flagged as still-unresolved since June and that hit semis hardest in the Aug 19 rout.
